final.name: Legal citation density
final.audit_justification: It scores only the density of citation apparatus, explicitly excluding correctness or usefulness, so it is a stylistic/domain fingerprint rather than substance, though heavy legal citation may track well-resourced drafters who also reason better.

final.name: Equity-Specific Impact Analysis
final.audit_justification: It requires identifying a specific affected group and a concrete mechanism, which is direct evidence of substantive analytic quality.

final.name: Implementation Feasibility
final.audit_justification: It measures whether the comment engages practical administrability of the proposal, a substantive dimension of the argument's content.

final.name: Explicit structural organization of distinct points
final.audit_justification: It is a pure layout/formatting marker (headings, numbering) independent of argument content, though organized formatting may correlate with professional drafters who also write better substance.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores only the presence of layout devices -- headings, numbering, an executive summary -- and never asks whether the labeled points contain any argument, so a comment could earn 10 for formatting an empty list. It is a document-preparation marker of professional drafting, which plausibly co-occurs with better substance but is not itself evidence about it.

final.name: Representational-mandate and constituency-size self-description
final.audit_justification: It measures how much space is spent on organizational self-description and explicitly disclaims judging credibility, making it a producer/identity fingerprint, though large well-staffed organizations may also produce better substantive analysis.
final.upstream_parent: institutional resources, membership scale and network of the submitter

final.name: Private interest translated into the agency's public criteria
final.audit_justification: It assesses whether the commenter's ask is actually argued in terms of the agency's substantive decision criteria, which is a reasoning-quality judgment.

final.name: Developed multi-step reasoning chain vs bare assertion
final.audit_justification: It directly measures presence and depth of a supporting reasoning chain versus bare assertion, core to argumentative quality.

final.name: Standing converted into otherwise-unavailable operational facts
final.audit_justification: It scores whether claimed standing is cashed out into concrete, otherwise-unavailable evidentiary facts, which is substantive evidentiary content.

final.name: Adds material to the record the agency did not have
final.audit_justification: It measures whether the comment contributes genuinely new evidence to the record, a direct substantive contribution.

final.name: Individually composed rather than templated or duplicated
final.audit_justification: It is fundamentally detecting template/mass-campaign origin versus individual authorship, a production-channel fingerprint, though individually composed text plausibly also carries more specific, substantively better reasoning.
final.arbiter_reason: The headline instruction asks whether the text 'was written for this proposal by this writer' and its discriminating low anchors key on campaign language, stock framings, and signature blocks revealing a mass-submission channel -- a fingerprint of who produced the comment and through what pipeline, which is the Track-B definition. The 10-vs-6 split does reach real content specificity, so individually composed comments plausibly carry genuinely better reasoning as well.

final.name: Orthographic noncompliance and unedited-typing residue
final.audit_justification: It is a density count of typos and mechanical errors that explicitly should not be read as judging carelessness or quality, and such surface noise has no plausible link to better substantive content.

final.name: Causal Mechanism
final.audit_justification: It measures whether the comment traces a causal chain from provision to concrete effects, a substantive analytic property.

final.name: Technical identifier density
final.audit_justification: It is a pure density count of technical identifiers with an explicit disclaimer against judging value, though it may co-occur with genuine domain expertise that also improves substance.

final.name: Procedural posture about deadlines, extensions and prior filings
final.audit_justification: It measures how much of the text is occupied by comment-process mechanics rather than the rule's merits, a topical/procedural marker orthogonal to substantive quality, and more process talk mostly just displaces substance rather than tracking a cause of better analysis.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing and process dynamics on the receiving side (comment-period length, docket renumbering, calendar conflicts)

final.name: Adoption-ready remedy joined to its justification
final.audit_justification: It scores whether a concrete, adoptable remedy is paired with a reasoned justification, a core substantive property of the argument.

final.name: Document bulk and verbosity
final.audit_justification: It is explicitly a measure of sheer bulk/verbosity with a disclaimer against judging value, though greater length may come from well-resourced drafters who also produce better substance.

final.name: Deadline and urgency language
final.audit_justification: It counts references to deadlines and urgency framing, a procedural/topical marker rather than substance, with no clear upstream cause that would also improve argument quality.

final.name: Adaptive Ongoing Support
final.audit_justification: It scores whether the comment recognizes changing conditions and calls for ongoing recurring measures rather than a one-off fix, a substantive policy-reasoning property.

final.name: OCR and transcription artifacts
final.audit_justification: It is a density count of scanning/transcription noise explicitly disclaimed as not reflecting value, and OCR artifacts are an artifact of the digitization pipeline unrelated to the writer's underlying quality.

final.name: Evidence Traceability
final.audit_justification: It measures whether factual claims are tied to traceable, identifiable sources, a substantive evidentiary property.

final.name: Submission-artifact markers
final.audit_justification: It counts visible submission artifacts like forwarding headers and file paths, a fingerprint of the submission channel with no plausible tie to substantive quality.

final.name: Density of formal legal/regulatory citations
final.audit_justification: It duplicates the citation-density framing of X01, scoring only the extent of formal legal apparatus and not its correct or persuasive use, though it may track legally-resourced drafters who also argue better.

final.name: Grounded Affected-Party Knowledge
final.audit_justification: It requires specific firsthand or professional experience that illuminates how the proposal actually operates, a substantive evidentiary property beyond a bare affiliation label.

final.name: Formal address to decision-maker as submission
final.audit_justification: It scores formal salutation/closing/docket-citation framing, a genre and formatting marker, though such formality may correlate with experienced submitters who also write more substantively.
final.arbiter_reason: It scores genre and packaging -- salutation, docket/RIN caption, identifying closing -- and the proposer's own example (R59) is conceded to have substantive technical content while scoring 0, which shows the criterion cuts across substance rather than tracking it. Formal captioning correlates with experienced institutional submitters who may also argue better, so it is mixed.

final.name: Contested consequential question versus ministerial housekeeping
final.audit_justification: It explicitly scores only what kind of question is engaged, not the precision or quality of engagement, making it a topic/stakes marker, though choosing to engage a genuinely contested question plausibly also invites deeper substantive analysis.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction explicitly directs the judge to 'score the question, not the precision,' so the score is set by which issue the docket put in front of the commenter rather than by anything the commenter did well -- a stakes/topic marker in the Track-B sense. Engaging a genuinely contested question does invite deeper analysis, so the underlying cause plausibly produces real quality too.
